summary: Recent discussions focus on optimizing Parquet performance and clarifying type semantics. Contributors are revising row group and page size recommendations, evaluating compression codecs, and resolving ambiguity in the FILE logical type when both inline data and URI are present.

highlights.text: Revising row group size recommendation to balance pruning, parallelism, writer memory, and footer size.
Benchmarking FastLanes: PFOR outperforms other codecs in decode throughput and compression ratio.
